observed.caption: A tall glass of bright blue iced drink garnished with mint and citrus sits on a wooden table in a sunlit cafe.
observed.description: A tall, curved clear glass filled with bright blue liquid and ice sits on a light brown wooden table in the foreground, garnished with a green-yellow citrus slice on its left rim, a cluster of fresh green mint leaves on its right rim, and two black straws extending upward; in the blurred background, a person wearing a dark vest over a light shirt sits on a gray mesh chair at a wooden table, with additional chairs, a light reflective floor, a white patterned ceiling with red trim, and large bright windows with sheer curtains visible in a sunlit indoor cafe setting.
